name: Ornan
summary: A Jebusite whose threshing floor David bought to build an altar to the LORD. The LORD stopped His angel there, and Solomon later built the house of the LORD on that spot.

key_moments.title: The Angel Over Jerusalem
key_moments.description: God sent an angel to destroy Jerusalem, but the LORD told him to stop beside Ornan's threshing floor. Ornan was threshing wheat when he turned and saw the angel, and his four sons hid.

key_moments.title: Sold for an Altar
key_moments.description: Ornan bowed to David and offered him the floor, the oxen and the wheat as a gift. David paid the full price, built an altar there, and the LORD answered him with fire from heaven.

key_moments.title: Where the Temple Was Built
key_moments.description: Solomon began to build the house of the LORD on Mount Moriah. It stood on the place David had prepared, the threshing floor of Ornan the Jebusite.
